note: Where the app's 'Open GitHub Discussions' button points. Set github_repo to "owner/repo" (public repository with Discussions enabled) and rebuild with tools/build_app.py. While it is null the app only offers 'Copy post text'. GitHub Discussions cannot be pre-filled from a link (to our knowledge), so the post text is copied and pasted. The app itself never makes a network request; opening the link is a navigation you start.
